root_cause.text: The `t7xx_dpmaif_set_frag_to_skb` function in the WWAN t7xx driver lacked a bounds check on `skb_shinfo(skb)->nr_frags` before calling `skb_add_rx_frag`, permitting the fragment count to exceed `MAX_SKB_FRAGS` and corrupt the `frags[]` array.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly states the function "adds page fragments to an skb without checking if the number of fragments has exceeded MAX_SKB_FRAGS," and the patch diff confirms the fix by inserting `if (shinfo->nr_frags >= MAX_SKB_FRAGS) return -EINVAL;` immediately before the `skb_add_rx_frag` invocation.
